dct_description_sm: This project addressed the importance of climate change adaptation at the community level with regards to the results of the 2007 National Assessment of climate change impacts and adaptation in Canada (From Impacts to Adaptation: Canada in a Change Climate 2007). The objectives were as follows: -To raise awareness of climate change risks and adaptation planning in Yukon communities by communicating the findings of the National Assessment; -To improve the capacity of communities for planning and implementing adaptation measures; -To integrate adaptation into policy, management and decision-making in Yukon; -To gather information/traditional knowledge concerning climate change; -To develop a risk management adaptation project; and -To develop tools for climate change adaptation.
